name: @motley-ai/slayer
description: TypeScript client for SLayer and the SLayer Gateway

scripts.gen: cd .. && poetry run python ts-sdk/scripts/openapi.py > ts-sdk/.openapi.json && cd ts-sdk && openapi-typescript .openapi.json -o src/schema.ts && rm .openapi.json
scripts.check:schema: npm run gen && git diff --exit-code -- src/schema.ts
